title: Elizondo regularly sees green orbs in his house
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Elizondo regularly sees green orbs in his house, about an unknown time at Elizondo's home, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: to regularly seeing green orbs in his house

what I do know are the facts that it was witnessed not only by me and my wife and my kids but also our neighbors uh but it occurred when I got into atip and it also was happening to other individuals that were part of that program
tellings.difference: Elizondo tells it firsthand. He says his wife, kids and neighbours also saw the orbs, that they began when he joined AATIP, and that other program members had the same experience.
tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the recurring green orbs at Elizondo's home.

as_told.title: Green orbs at Elizondo's home after he joined AATIP

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that Lou Elizondo, a former defense intelligence official, regularly sees green orbs in his house. Elizondo himself says his wife, his children and his neighbours saw them too. He says they started when he joined AATIP, a small Pentagon office that studied unexplained aerial reports, and that other people in that programme had the same thing happen, which would suggest the phenomenon follows the people who study it.
